message: Renovate packageRules[0] in renovate.json sets minimumReleaseAge: "1 hour" for matchManagers ["{npm,bun}"], which depcurfew cannot read, so it cannot tell whether Renovate waits as long as npm (3 days, min-release-age: 3 in .npmrc)
fix: Make sure packageRules[0] of renovate.json gives these packages a minimumReleaseAge of at least 3 days, or write its matchManagers with names, * or /regex/ patterns, which depcurfew reads
